description: Ice (Internet Communications Engine) is an RPC framework for building networked applications in C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, MATLAB, PHP, Python, Ruby, and Swift. You define interfaces in Slice and invoke operations on remote Ice objects through generated proxies.
rules: These docs cover Ice 3.8. Ice 3.7 APIs differ, so check the upgrade guide before reusing Ice 3.7 code with Ice 3.8.
In C++, Ice 3.8 has a single C++17 mapping: create a communicator with Ice::initialize and keep it in an Ice::CommunicatorHolder. There is no Ice::Application class.
Ice and IceRPC are separate frameworks with different APIs: don't use IceRPC docs or samples for Ice code.
